Which part of Koh Samui is best for families with young children? | Choeng Mon on the north-east tip: a sheltered bay with soft sand, a gentle slope and usually flat water, beach restaurants and the airport 5–10 minutes away. North Chaweng is the runner-up if you want restaurants and shops within walking distance.
Which Koh Samui beach is safest for toddlers? | Choeng Mon and Lipa Noi. Choeng Mon is the calmest bay on the east side, and Lipa Noi on the west coast has very shallow, wave-free water at mid to high tide. On any beach, avoid red-flag days, swim at mid to high tide on the north and west coasts and stay out of the water at dusk.
~Is Chaweng too busy for families? | Central Chaweng is loud at night around the bars, but North Chaweng is quiet, has the gentlest water on the beach and keeps Chaweng's restaurants and hospitals close, so it works well for families. Red flags are common from October to December.
~Is Lipa Noi good for kids? | Yes for babies and toddlers who want to paddle: the water is very shallow and calm, with a sandy bottom. The downsides are 40–50 minutes to the airport, few restaurants, flats at low tide and a 400 THB per person return surcharge on our east-side boat trips.
How close are hospitals to family areas? | Bangkok Hospital Samui (paediatrics, 24-hour emergency room) is about 5 minutes from Chaweng Noi and 10–20 minutes from Chaweng, Choeng Mon and Lamai. Bophut and Maenam are close to Bandon International. On the west coast the nearest emergency room is the government hospital near Nathon.
Are your tours suitable for children? | Yes. Children's life jackets are provided on every boat, children aged 3–11 pay a child rate and infants 0–2 travel free. The Pig Island speedboat (4–5 hours) is the easiest trip for young children; Ang Thong by big boat suits ages 6 and up, and Koh Tao suits 8 and up.
Do Koh Samui pool villas have pool fences? | Most don't. If you travel with toddlers, ask the owner for photos of the pool area and whether a removable fence or a pool alarm is available before you book, and check whether the access road is steep.
Is Bophut a good area for families? | For food and atmosphere yes, but not for swimming: the beach at Bophut is narrow and the water often shallow and cloudy. Families who stay there usually drive 15 minutes to Choeng Mon or Chaweng for beach time.
